description:
Temp Table Disk Storm — WARN0306

Reads PFS to detect queries creating on-disk temporary tables. Fires when:
- On-disk tmp count >= disk-tmp-threshold (default 20), or
- disk_tmp / (disk_tmp + mem_tmp) >= ratio-threshold (default 20%)

Common causes: missing indexes on GROUP BY/ORDER BY columns, or tmp_table_size too small.

prerequisites.description: Performance Schema query digest monitoring must be enabled (monitoring-performance-schema-queries=true)

config_keys.label: On-disk tmp table threshold
config_keys.help: Fires when total count of PFS queries creating on-disk temporary tables reaches this value.

config_keys.label: Disk/total tmp ratio threshold
config_keys.help: Fires when fraction of temporary tables spilling to disk exceeds this ratio.

config_keys.label: Min execution count
config_keys.help: Query digests with fewer total executions are ignored.
